seo.metaTitle: QR code generator & Wi-Fi card — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Generate high-contrast QR codes for website links, Wi-Fi logins, or vCards locally with zero tracking redirects. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/image/qr-tool-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: QR code generator & Wi-Fi card processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/image/qr-tool-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does QR code generator & Wi-Fi card upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. QR code generator & Wi-Fi card executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/image/qr-tool-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate QR code generator & Wi-Fi card?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/qr_tool.json or open /tools/qr-tool?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
